title: Mom Said: If I Call You From Upstairs, Don't Answer
description: She left at 9. At 10, she called us from upstairs. Then my phone buzzed… Which mom is real? 👇

scenes.narration: At ten p.m., my mom called us from upstairs. But she had left the house an hour ago.
Before she left, she knelt down and whispered: if you hear me call from upstairs, don't answer. It's not me.
Then she locked the door from the outside. My little sister Lily laughed. I didn't.
We sat on the couch with every light on. The TV kept flickering.
At ten, we heard footsteps. Upstairs. Slow. Heavy. Walking from room to room.
Then mom's voice: kids? Can you come up here for a second?
Lily stood up. I grabbed her arm. Because only mom calls her Lily-bug.
It said it fell. That it was hurt. Then it started crying. It sounded *exactly* like her.

scenes.phone: Don't go upstairs. I'm still in the car. Whatever you hear, it's NOT me.

scenes.narration: Ten seconds later, the front door opened. Mom walked in, out of breath.

scenes.reply: DON'T LET HER IN! THAT'S NOT ME!
scenes.narration: And from upstairs, mom's voice screamed: don't let her in! That's *not* me!

scenes.reply: DON'T LET HER IN! THAT'S NOT ME!
scenes.narration: Two moms. Same voice. Same face. Which one do we run to? Tell me.
